caption: The drawing depicts a skeletal human figure seated on a wooden cart. The figure is shown holding a bow and an arrow in a drawing position, with one hand gripping the bow and the other pulling back the arrow on the string. The wooden cart features a slatted construction with horizontal logs forming the sides and back, and is mounted on two large, spoked wheels. There is a wooden platform or seat with a backrest on which the figure sits, supported by vertical wooden posts. Attached to the front axle area of the cart is a large, curved, U-shaped wooden implement. The drawing is rendered in fine detail with inks and shades of brown, beige, and light gray. Below the main illustration are three smaller inset sketches: one showing a hatchet and a hammer, another displaying a close-up of one of the cart's wooden wheels, and the third showing a side view of the skeletal figure on the cart holding the bow. In the lower left, a scale for the cart, figure, hatchet, and hammer is provided, along with the signature “Eldora H. Lorenzin 1937.”
title: Death Angel and Cart
